avoid.label: What we don’t tell them
avoid.hint: What would make the email miss the mark: jargon, topics outside their situation, promises.

concerns.label: What’s on their mind
concerns.hint: The questions they really ask themselves — those are the ones the email answers.

editorialVoice.label: The tone to use
editorialVoice.hint: How we talk to them: educational, direct, friendly…

interests.label: What interests them
interests.hint: The topics that get them to open an email.

knowledgeLevel.label: How well they know the subject
knowledgeLevel.hint: Beginner, informed, expert: this decides what we explain and what we don’t explain again.

persona.label: Who this person is
persona.hint: One or two sentences: their situation, what they’re going through right now.
